blocks.text: The module documents proposal ownership and explains that proposal operations have a distinct lifecycle from workspace file CRUD. Each route rechecks workspace ownership before touching proposal storage.
blocks.title: Router ownership contract

blocks.text: Pydantic models carry chat-edit instructions and refs, wireframe HTML, or per-file decisions. Ref dictionaries remain loose because the frontend reference shape can grow independently.
blocks.title: Request models

blocks.text: The create route checks workspace ownership, delegates generation, and returns generation failures as stored failed proposals while request-shape errors become 400 responses.
blocks.title: Chat-edit proposal creation

blocks.text: Wireframe creation returns a pending file proposal without an LLM call. List and get routes delegate to proposal storage after ownership checks.
blocks.title: Wireframe, list, and get routes

blocks.text: The resolve route dumps file decisions and delegates them to proposal code. It distinguishes stale proposals, missing proposals, and invalid already-resolved or decision states.
blocks.title: Proposal resolution

gotchas: Wireframe proposals do not call an LLM
Only resolve turns proposed text into project file writes
how_it_works: Validates workspace ownership before proposal operations
Accepts loose reference dictionaries and wireframe HTML
Delegates synchronous chat-edit generation or immediate wireframe proposal creation
Resolves file decisions and maps stale or validation failures to HTTP statuses
purpose: This router exposes the proposal lifecycle behind Edit mode and separates proposal resources from plain workspace file CRUD. It checks workspace ownership before delegating proposal generation or resolution to eo/code_proposals.
side_effects: project file writes only during resolution
summary: FastAPI routes for creating, listing, viewing, resolving, and wireframing code proposals in a workspace.

symbols.summary: Describes one proposed file and whether it should be accepted, rejected, or partially resolved.

raises: HTTPException 400 for invalid request or generation input
side_effects: LLM calls and proposal database writes through eo/code_proposals
symbols.summary: Creates a chat-edit proposal synchronously through the code-proposal generator.
Creates a pending index.html proposal from wireframe HTML without generation.
Lists workspace proposals, optionally filtered by status.

raises: HTTPException 404 for unknown workspace or proposal
symbols.summary: Returns one workspace proposal including original and proposed file shapes.

raises: HTTPException 400 for invalid or resolved proposal
symbols.summary: Applies file decisions and writes accepted proposed content into workspace files.
